GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.8 (20 Apr 46) CIE
(SCAPIN - 886)
APO 500
20 April 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Action to Be Taken Concerning Ichimaru, Eiji Instructor Saikai Middle School. Sasebo-shi, Nagasaki-ken.
The Imperial Japanese Government, on receipt of this Memorandum, will dismiss ICHIMARU, Eiji, instructor, Saikai Middle School, Sasebo-Shi, Nagasaki-Ken, and will prohibit his future employment by any Japanese educational institutions or agencies, either public or private.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
